list: the official 55 trophies, 2026-11-18 (names and descriptions as PlayStation publishes them)
note: Guides are written in the author's own words for this entry. Names and descriptions are the official ones; every guide cites its sources. Counts (stunts, vehicles, spots) are as the trophy tracker and PowerPyx report them at launch.

trophies.guide: The platinum unlocks automatically once the other 54 trophies are all earned, so there is nothing to do for this one directly. Follow the five-stage roadmap: finish the story, clear the 100% checklist, close out the stranger and side questlines, clean up money and collections, then mop up the odd jobs. It usually pops the moment the last remaining trophy lands, around 200 hours in.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

steps: Earn the other 54 trophies in any order.
Use the roadmap tab to see which stage each trophy belongs to.
The platinum unlocks on its own when the final trophy pops.

trophies.guide: This is an early story trophy that comes from playing the Gone Fishing mission to the end. Just follow the pink main-mission marker when it appears and play through the mission as directed. It cannot be missed — story missions stay available until you finish them.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

steps: Follow the pink marker to start Gone Fishing.
Play the mission through to its ending cutscene.
The trophy pops when the mission completes.

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1 and the trophy pops when the chapter closes. Before the chapter ends, do the one thing in the game that can be missed: the balcony moment with Lucia at Jason's house, right after the mission Down to Earth, when she says she is going out to the balcony in the morning — follow her and choose Accept. Keep a manual save at the start of each chapter as a safety net, since there is no mission replay.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

steps: After Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning and accept the meditation.
Play the remaining Chapter 1 missions to the end.
The trophy pops when Chapter 1 closes.

trophies.guide: Play through all of Chapter 2's missions and the trophy pops at the chapter's end. The final spot for the missable Positive Mental Attitude trophy needs both Lucia and Jason together, which only becomes possible after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, so keep that in mind while you work through the spots. Nothing in this chapter can be missed.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

steps: Follow the pink markers through every Chapter 2 mission.
After Coffee Break, both characters can meditate together at the final spot.
The trophy pops when Chapter 2 closes.

trophies.guide: Finish the Chapter 3 mission chain and the trophy pops when the chapter wraps up. Keep scanning new vehicles with WAiNK and studying animals with the binoculars as you travel, since that progress counts toward the 100% checklist later. No mission in this chapter can be missed.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

steps: Play every Chapter 3 mission to completion.
Scan vehicles and study animals along the way.
The trophy pops when Chapter 3 closes.

trophies.guide: Complete all of Chapter 4's missions and the trophy pops at the chapter's close. By now the optional missions are worth doing as they appear, since several of them unlock systems other trophies need, such as the Key Cloner, jewelry robberies and bank vaults. Nothing here can be missed.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

steps: Play every Chapter 4 mission to completion.
Do optional missions as they appear to unlock robbery systems.
The trophy pops when Chapter 4 closes.

trophies.guide: This gold trophy is for finishing the last mission of the story, which closes out Chapter 5 and rolls the credits. There are no mission gold medals to worry about and no mission replay, so just play the final mission through. After the credits you return to free-roam and the 100% checklist appears.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

steps: Play the final story mission to its ending.
Watch the credits roll.
The trophy pops when the final mission completes.

trophies.guide: Breakfast Run is a story mission, so this trophy comes from simply playing it through to the end. Follow the pink marker when the mission becomes available and complete its objectives. Story missions cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Trust

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

steps: Follow the pink marker to start Breakfast Run.
Complete the mission objectives.
The trophy pops when the mission ends.

trophies.guide: The Cartel Heist is a story mission, so just play it from its pink marker to the finish. Heist missions tend to be longer and multi-part, so take your time with the objectives and keep a manual save from the start of the chapter. The trophy pops when the heist is done.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

steps: Follow the pink marker to start The Cartel Heist.
Work through each part of the heist.
The trophy pops when the heist completes.

trophies.guide: Child's Play is a story mission, so this trophy is earned by playing it through to its conclusion. Follow the pink marker, complete the mission's objectives, and the trophy pops at the end. It cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Family Matters

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

steps: Follow the pink marker to start Child's Play.
Complete the mission objectives.
The trophy pops when the mission ends.

trophies.guide: Headliners is a story mission, so play it from its pink marker through to the ending. The mission's name hints at a big set piece, so expect a longer sequence with several objectives before the trophy pops. It cannot be missed.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

steps: Follow the pink marker to start Headliners.
Complete each objective in the mission.
The trophy pops when the mission ends.

trophies.guide: VCIA Takedown is a story mission set around the Vice City airport, so play it through from its pink marker to the end. The airport is also the place for the free-roam plane theft trophy later, so getting familiar with its layout here helps. The trophy pops when the mission completes.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

steps: Follow the pink marker to start VCIA Takedown.
Complete the mission objectives at the airport.
The trophy pops when the mission ends.

trophies.guide: Operation Savage Glory is a story mission, so this trophy comes from playing it to the end. Follow the pink marker and work through the mission's objectives; like the other named story missions it cannot be missed and stays available until finished.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

steps: Follow the pink marker to start Operation Savage Glory.
Complete the mission objectives.
The trophy pops when the mission ends.

trophies.guide: After the credits, the 100% Completion Checklist appears under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion. It is far more forgiving than it sounds — closer to 60% of everything: any 100 optional missions, any 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned, any 100 of 255 animals studied, 300 stunts and any 70 of 80 challenges. Only the robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests need to be fully completed, so focus your cleanup there.
trophies.name: A Long Road

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

steps: Finish the story, then open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion.
Clear the partial categories: 100 optional missions, 200 vehicles, 100 animals, 300 stunts, 70 challenges.
Complete every robbery, underwater discovery, shooting range, drone race and Bret quest.
The trophy pops when the checklist hits 100%.

trophies.guide: Stunts are the jumps, near-misses and airtime challenges scattered across Leonida — 397 in total, and you need 250 of them. They build up naturally while driving fast and messing around, but the quickest route is to work through them deliberately with a fast car on the long straight roads and ramps. The 100% checklist wants 300 stunts, so keep going past 250.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

steps: Drive fast, jump ramps and chase airtime to complete stunts.
Track progress under Progress > Stats.
Reach 250 completed stunts for the trophy; push to 300 for the 100% checklist.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: There are 9 activity types across Leonida — things like racing, fishing, shooting ranges, drone races, arcade games and more. You only need to try each one once, not master it, so this is a quick tour rather than a grind. Open the activities list in the pause menu or check the map icons and tick them off one by one.
trophies.name: Master of None

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

steps: Find one activity of each of the 9 types on the map.
Start and finish each activity once.
The trophy pops after the ninth type is tried.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: The shooting ranges hold 42 challenges, and every one of them needs a gold medal. This is a pure skill trophy: learn each range's layout, pick the right weapon for the distance, and use Combat Focus to steady your aim on the harder targets. Unlike the 100% checklist, which only needs the ranges completed, this one demands gold across the board, so expect to replay the trickiest challenges.
trophies.name: The Shootist

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

steps: Visit every shooting range location.
Earn a gold medal in each of the 42 challenges.
Replay any challenge that lands below gold until all 42 are gold.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Top Fun runs drone races at 14 locations around Leonida, and you need a win at each one. Drone handling is its own skill — learn the gates, cut corners where the course allows, and keep the drone low and fast. The races also count toward the 100% checklist, which needs all of them, so this trophy and the checklist line up.
trophies.name: Top Fun

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

steps: Find the Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations.
Win the race at each location.
The trophy pops after the fourteenth win.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races across Leonida — street races, off-road events, boat and bike races all count as long as each race is a different one. You do not need to win the same race twice. Pick the right vehicle for each event, learn the routes, and use slipstreaming on the long straights.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

steps: Find race events on the map — street, off-road, boat and bike.
Win each race; every different race counts once.
The trophy pops after your twentieth different win.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Cal is the fishing rival you meet while fishing around Leonida. Challenge him and out-fish him — the trick is steady reeling, keeping the line tension in the safe zone and not letting the fish snap it. Fishing also feeds into the 100% checklist's optional missions, so the time spent here is not wasted.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

steps: Go fishing and meet Cal at a fishing spot.
Accept his fishing challenge.
Out-fish him to win the challenge and the trophy.

trophies.guide: Find one of the arcade cabinets in Leonida — there are 4 games spread across the arcades — and play one through to completion. You do not need a high score, just a finished game. The arcades are easy to spot on the map, and this is one of the quickest trophies in the whole list.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

steps: Find an arcade and walk up to a cabinet.
Start one of the 4 arcade games.
Play it through to completion for the trophy.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy gives Lucia a questline of 5 missions, and the trophy pops when the last one is done. These missions unlock as you progress through the story and free-roam, so check your phone and map for Andy's markers after the story. This is a Lucia-only questline, so switch to her when Andy calls.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

steps: Play as Lucia and follow Andy's quest markers.
Complete all 5 of Andy's missions in order.
The trophy pops after the final mission.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's questline is about treasure diving: 7 shipwrecks scattered in Leonida's waters, each holding something worth finding. Dive each wreck, grab the treasure, and work through Kenton's missions until the final one. Bring a boat, watch your oxygen, and use the dive spots marked on the map.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

steps: Meet Kenton and start his treasure-diving questline.
Dive all 7 shipwrecks and recover their treasure.
Complete Kenton's final mission for the trophy.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy runs the Thrillbilly Mudclub, and his questline is 5 missions of muddy off-road chaos. Follow Billy's markers, win or finish his mud events, and keep going until the final mission. A good off-road vehicle makes the whole questline much easier.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

steps: Meet Billy at the Thrillbilly Mudclub.
Complete all 5 of Billy's missions.
The trophy pops after the final mission.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Strangers & Freaks missions come from the odd characters marked with a question mark across Leonida, and 8 full strands count toward this trophy — Kirk, Kyle, Yago, Pilot Pete and more. Each strand is a short chain of missions, so follow the question marks, finish each chain, and keep count. These are not needed for the 100% checklist, which is why they get their own stage in the roadmap.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

steps: Follow the question-mark markers to meet strangers across Leonida.
Finish each stranger's full mission strand.
The trophy pops after the eighth strand is complete.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's questline revolves around 16 sports cars — finding them, delivering them or racing them, depending on the mission. Work through his markers one by one until the final mission. Keep a fast sports car in your garage for the driving missions, since several of them are timed.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

steps: Meet Randy and start his sports-car questline.
Work through the 16-car chain of missions.
Complete Randy's final mission for the trophy.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's questline is short — just 2 quests — but it is Jason-only and set around Synthetic Labs, so switch to Jason when his markers appear. Follow the quest markers, finish both quests, and the trophy pops after the second one. It stays available after the story, so there is no rush.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

steps: Play as Jason and follow Tyrone's markers to Synthetic Labs.
Complete the first quest, then the second.
The trophy pops after Tyrone's final mission.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: This is the ONLY missable trophy in the game, so read this carefully: there are 18 meditation spots across 10 locations in Leonida, both Lucia and Jason can meditate at each spot (each character at the same location counts as +2), and you can track them under Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations. First, the Chapter 1 meditation at Jason's house disappears after Chapter 1 — after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, when she says she is going to meditate and walks out to the balcony, follow her and choose Accept; it adds +1 to the counter but is not marked as a spot like the rest, and it is still unconfirmed whether it is required, so doing it is the safe move. Second, the final meditation needs both characters together, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. Note that the 100% checklist only needs 15 of 18 meditations, so this trophy is stricter than the checklist here.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
steps: In Chapter 1, after Down to Earth, accept Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house.
Meditate at all 18 spots with both characters; check Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations.
After Coffee Break in Chapter 2, do the final meditation with both characters together.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret is the hunting contact, and his questline asks Jason to hunt unique animals — 15 target decks in total. This is Jason-only, so switch to him when Bret's markers appear. Track the animals, stalk them quietly, and take clean shots. Bret's quests also need to be fully completed for the 100% checklist, so this trophy and the checklist overlap.
trophies.name: Fair Game

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

steps: Play as Jason and meet Bret to start his hunting questline.
Hunt the unique animals across the 15 target decks.
The trophy pops after Bret's final hunt.

trophies.guide: Collectible cards are hidden all over Leonida in 18 full sets, and you only need to complete 3 of them. Cards turn up in shops, in the world and as mission rewards, so grab them whenever you see one and trade or buy the missing pieces. Focus on the three easiest sets first rather than chasing every card in the game.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

steps: Collect cards from shops, the world and mission rewards.
Track which sets are closest to complete.
Finish any 3 full sets for the trophy.

trophies.guide: WAiNK is the in-game phone app for scanning things — vehicles, animals, landmarks and more. For this trophy you need to WAiNK it at 100 different locations across Leonida. Just open the app whenever you arrive somewhere new and scan what is around you; the count climbs fast if you make a habit of it during the story and free-roam.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

steps: Open the WAiNK app at new locations around Leonida.
Scan landmarks, vehicles and animals as you travel.
The trophy pops at 100 WAiNK locations.

trophies.guide: There are 80 challenges scattered through the game's activities — stunts, races, shooting ranges, drone races and more — and you need 50 of them done. Pick the easiest challenges first and let the count grow while you work on the other trophies; the 100% checklist wants 70 of 80, so you will pass 50 on the way there.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

steps: Open the challenges list and pick the easiest ones first.
Complete challenges across stunts, races and ranges.
The trophy pops at 50 completed challenges.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: You need a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then you have to lose the cops and escape clean. The trick is to build the wanted level in a quiet area, then drive into the countryside or into water where the search cone fades, and stay out of sight until the stars clear. Doing it with your partner along is the key part — solo escapes do not count.
trophies.name: Hot Together

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

steps: Bring your partner along, then raise a 4-star wanted level.
Break line of sight and get far from the search area.
Stay hidden until the wanted level clears for the trophy.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, rob 3 shops in a row without letting your wanted level drop in between. Plan a route with three close shops, hit them one after another, and keep moving — if the cops lose you and the stars clear, the chain breaks and you start over. A fast getaway car parked nearby makes this much easier.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

steps: Bring your partner and pick 3 shops close together.
Rob the first shop, then the second and third without losing your wanted level.
The trophy pops after the third robbery in the chain.

trophies.guide: Discovering a vehicle means finding a new model and scanning it with WAiNK — 100 different vehicles for this trophy. There are 277 base models in the game, so you have plenty to choose from. Scan everything new you see while driving around, check car parks and traffic in different districts, and the count climbs on its own.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

steps: Scan every new vehicle model you see with WAiNK.
Visit different districts and car parks for variety.
The trophy pops at 100 discovered vehicles.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus is the slow-motion aiming mode, and this trophy wants 5 enemies downed in a single use of it. Find a spot with a cluster of enemies — a gang hideout or a robbery shootout works well — trigger Combat Focus, and drop five before the meter runs out. A high-damage weapon and good positioning make it far easier than spraying wildly.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

steps: Find a fight with at least 5 enemies grouped together.
Activate Combat Focus and take down 5 enemies before it ends.
The trophy pops once the fifth enemy falls in the same use.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Head to Vice City International Airport, steal a plane, and take off without filing a flight plan — an unscheduled departure. The airport is guarded, so expect a wanted level the moment you grab the plane; get to the runway fast, lift off, and fly clear of the airport airspace. The trophy pops once you are airborne and away.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

steps: Go to VCIA and find a plane on the tarmac or in a hangar.
Steal the plane and taxi to a runway.
Take off and fly clear of the airport for the trophy.

trophies.guide: The Rhino is the army tank, and this trophy is for stealing one. Tanks show up at military areas and sometimes in high-wanted-level responses, so the practical route is to slip into a military compound, grab the Rhino, and drive it out through the gate. Expect heavy resistance — armor and a quick escape route help a lot.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

steps: Find a Rhino tank at a military area.
Steal it and drive it out of the compound.
The trophy pops once the Rhino is yours.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Pick a jewelry store, case it first, and rob it without ever being detected — no alarms, no witnesses calling the cops, no cameras catching you. The Key Cloner and other robbery tools unlocked through optional missions help here. Go in quiet, grab the goods, and slip out before anyone raises the alarm.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

steps: Scout a jewelry store and plan a quiet entry.
Rob the store without triggering an alarm or being spotted.
Escape undetected for the trophy.

trophies.guide: There are 8 bank vaults in Leonida, and you need to rob 5 of them and escape with the cash. Vault robberies are the big paydays of the game — each one can pay up to $205,000 — so they also fund the money trophies. Plan each vault, bring the right tools, and have a getaway route ready before you go in.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

steps: Unlock bank vault robberies through the story and optional missions.
Rob a vault and escape with the cash.
Repeat until 5 vaults are robbed for the trophy.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Armored trucks drive set routes around Leonida. Ram one to a stop or block it, crack it open, grab the cash and escape before the cops box you in. A fast car and a planned escape route matter more than firepower — the truck itself is slow, but the response is not.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

steps: Find an armored truck on its route and stop it.
Break in and take the cash.
Escape the police for the trophy.

trophies.guide: Leonida is divided into 52 areas, and you need to unfog every one of them on the map. Just drive, fly and sail into each area until the map fills in — the fog lifts as you pass through. The easiest way is a long road trip around the state after the story, hitting the rural corners and islands you never visited during missions.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

steps: Open the map and note which areas are still fogged.
Travel through each fogged area until it unfogs.
The trophy pops when all 52 areas are explored.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Nine gangs run illegal operations around Leonida, and you need to rob one operation belonging to each of them. These are marked on the map once unlocked, and each robbery plays a little differently depending on the gang. Work through the list gang by gang and the trophy pops after the ninth.
trophies.name: Pest Control

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

steps: Find illegal operations on the map for each of the 9 gangs.
Rob one operation per gang.
The trophy pops after the ninth gang's operation.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Head to Ocean Beach, find a bar with a view over the water, and order a cocktail. This is one of the game's relaxing odd-job trophies — no combat, no timer, just a drink with a view. Sit down, order, and the trophy pops while you enjoy the sunset.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

steps: Go to Ocean Beach and find a beachfront bar.
Order a cocktail and enjoy the view.
The trophy pops once the drink is served.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: This is a homage to the classic series moment: drive a car straight through a vehicle showroom's front window and smash your way out. Pick a showroom, build up speed on the street outside, and drive through the glass. Any car works — the drama is the point, not the vehicle.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

steps: Find a vehicle showroom with a glass front.
Build speed and drive straight through the window.
The trophy pops as you smash out.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Head to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and follow through on what the place offers — there are 3 valuables to find or collect there. Explore the alley, check the lanes and the back rooms, and pick up each valuable. The trophy pops once all three are collected.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

steps: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Find and collect all 3 valuables inside.
The trophy pops after the third valuable.

trophies.guide: This trophy is about reaching maximum strength with both characters — a partnership where both Lucia and Jason are at their strongest. Build up each character's strength through workouts and physical activities until both are maxed out. It takes a while, so fold it into your free-roam routine rather than grinding it in one sitting.
trophies.name: Personal Best

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

steps: Build Lucia's strength to maximum through workouts.
Build Jason's strength to maximum the same way.
The trophy pops when both characters are at max strength.

trophies.guide: Your criminal profile tracks 500 actions — choices made for better or worse, from robberies and getaways to the small misdeeds in between. It builds up across everything you do in free-roam, so just keep playing the way you normally would and check the profile counter now and then. By the time you finish the other cleanup trophies, this one is usually close or done.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

steps: Play normally in free-roam — robberies, races and getaways all count.
Check your criminal profile counter under Progress.
The trophy pops at 500 recorded actions.

trophies.guide: This one is tied to the Payday Loans second chance — a cryptic trophy that only makes sense once you find the Payday Loans setup and take the second chance it offers. Look for the Payday Loans markers in free-roam, take the loan or the deal, and when the second chance comes around, take it. The trophy pops on the second attempt.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

steps: Find the Payday Loans setup in free-roam.
Take the first chance it offers.
Take the second chance when it comes for the trophy.

trophies.guide: This is the UFO easter egg trophy. Somewhere in Leonida, at the right place and the right time, something strange happens in the sky — and if you are there to see it, the trophy pops. The easter egg is deliberately cryptic, so watch for odd lights at night in remote areas, and check the community guides for the exact spot and conditions once you are in free-roam.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

steps: In free-roam, head to a remote area at night.
Watch for strange lights in the sky — the UFO easter egg.
Be there when it happens for the trophy.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: A melee drive-by means leaning out of a moving car and swinging a melee weapon at people — and this trophy wants 10 bowled over within 60 seconds. Find a crowded sidewalk, get a car, and drive slowly along the crowd swinging away. The timer starts with the first hit, so line up a dense group before you start.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

steps: Find a crowded sidewalk and get a car with a melee weapon equipped.
Drive slowly along the crowd and swing at pedestrians.
Bowl over 10 within 60 seconds for the trophy.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Marked bills come from robberies, and they need laundering through a fence or contact before they are clean money. Keep robbing vaults and shops, hand the marked bills to your laundering contact, and the clean total climbs. Bank vaults pay up to $205,000 each, so a couple of vaults plus shop takings get you to $250,000 without much extra grinding.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

steps: Rob vaults and shops to collect marked bills.
Launder the bills through your fence contact.
The trophy pops at $250,000 laundered.

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all the shops in Leonida — clothes, weapons, car mods, food, anything counts. The total is cumulative across every shop, so just buy the gear you actually want while playing and the number climbs. If you need to top it up at the end, car modifications and high-end clothes are the fastest way to burn cash.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

steps: Buy weapons, clothes, car mods and food across Leonida's shops.
Track the cumulative spend — every shop counts.
The trophy pops at $100,000 spent.

trophies.guide: There are 8 purchasable garages across Leonida, bought through the Vice City Real Estate app on your phone, for $160,000 in total. Open the app, browse the properties, and buy each garage one by one. They are also useful for storing the vehicles you collect, so this trophy pays for itself in storage space.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

steps: Open the Vice City Real Estate app on your phone.
Buy each of the 8 garages — $160,000 total.
The trophy pops after the eighth purchase.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Scooter Bros is the vehicle app on your phone, and this trophy wants 10 vehicles registered to it. Drive or ride a vehicle, open the app, and register it — then repeat with nine more different vehicles. Any vehicle counts, so use the cars and bikes you already own or find on the street.
trophies.name: On the Spot

sources.name: Sixshore — GTA 6 Trophy and Achievement List

steps: Get in any vehicle and open the Scooter Bros app.
Register the vehicle to the app.
Repeat with 10 different vehicles for the trophy.
